title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its U.S. smart ring comeback
snippet: Oura alleges in its newest lawsuit that Ultrahuman's Ring Pro infringes two of its patents.

title: Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
snippet: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.

title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
snippet: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.
